verdict.rationale: Omarchy is itself a host Linux distro. Its only relevant documented capability is a single line saying all of Omarchy can run in a virtual machine 'so you can get a taste first' [omarchy-docs-40], framed as a trial rather than a supported dev environment on another host OS. Its Windows VM feature runs the other way (Windows inside Omarchy), and dual-boot is not hosted, so neither counts. A community note that Hyprland doesn't work well in VMs is a general caveat rather than a concrete failure of Omarchy's VM. Missing for 10: documented host OS support (macOS/Windows), VM setup instructions, a terminal-only or WSL-style mode for development tooling, host file and tool integration, and hands-on corroboration of the VM experience.
